de19_access.topic: DOGE access to federal systems: Treasury, SSA, NLRB, IRS, six agencies; audits and whistleblowers

claims.text: GAO-26-108131: reviewed Treasury DOGE team access 20 Jan-11 Apr 2025; one DOGE employee had access to three BFS payment systems Jan-Feb 2025 and could view, copy and print data; was 'inadvertently granted temporary access to create, modify, and delete data' in one system; GAO found no evidence data was changed; employee sent payment information unencrypted to another agency's DOGE team without approval; BFS fully implemented 5 of 14 selected controls; did not ensure employee agreed to IT security rules before receiving laptop; DLP not configured to block unencrypted payment information; six recommendations, all open, BFS agreed with three

GAO-26-108192 (29 Sep 2026): CFPB, Education, NOAA and SEC reported DOGE teams had access to more than 23 systems; extent 'could not be determined'; SBA and VA did not identify systems; only SEC documented background investigations; CFPB and Education gave none; agencies did not let GAO observe logs; NOAA and SEC questioned GAO's authority, VA would not address requests; 'Congress and the public lack assurance' systems and data were protected; CFPB disputed accuracy

GAO-26-108583: about 378,000 separations from 22 CFO Act agencies in 2025 (65% in second half), about 127,000 hires incl. temporary; net decline nearly 256,000, more than 11%, Dec 2024 to Jan 2026; from about 1% at DHS to over 45% at Education; 18 of 22 agencies fell more than 10%; SBA and USAID did not provide data

Borges complaint (Aug 2025): DOGE staff moved NUMIDENT (SSNs, names, addresses, birthplaces, parents' names; more than 300 million Americans) in June 2025 to a cloud environment only DOGE could access 'without any independent security or oversight mechanisms'; CIO Aram Moghaddassi's 15 July memo: 'the business need is higher than the security risk'; SSA security assessment warned of 'catastrophic impact' if breached; SSA: data 'walled off from the internet', 'not aware of any compromise'

DOJ filing disclosed 20 Jan 2026: DOGE members at SSA used Cloudflare to share SSA data; 'Cloudflare is not approved for storing SSA data'; SSA 'has not been able to determine exactly what data were shared'; unnamed advocacy group contacted two SSA DOGE members in March 2025 aiming 'to find evidence of voter fraud and to overturn election results in certain States'; one signed an agreement possibly involving SSA data to match voter rolls; filing does not say whether data was shared; SSA referred two employees to OSC for possible Hatch Act violations late Dec 2025; filing corrects earlier SSA testimony

SSA OIG letter 6 Mar 2026: reviewing anonymous complaint on 'potential misuse of SSA data by a former DOGE employee'; reported allegations (Washington Post) of NUMIDENT and Death Master File copies, thumb drive; SSA: allegations 'strongly refuted by all named parties'; no findings

Berulis (NLRB security architect) letter to Senate Intelligence Committee 14 Apr 2025: DOGE 'tenant admin' accounts from 3 Mar; about 10 GB moved from NxGen early 4 Mar; logs missing and network watcher off; 20+ login attempts from Russian IP with valid credentials blocked; threatening note 7 Apr; NLRB: DOGE 'neither requested nor received access', 'no breach of agency systems occurred'

GAO-26-108774 (28 Apr 2026): two GSA detailees as NLRB DOGE team 16 Apr-25 Jul 2025 requested access to seven HR systems; two accounts created 24 Apr never activated, later disabled; 'no evidence that DOGE accessed the systems during the agreement period'; GAO did not review before 16 Apr to avoid overlapping NLRB IG investigation of the March 2025 allegation, which remains open

Wired via TechCrunch 5 Apr 2025: DOGE staffers Gavin Kliger and Sam Corcos planned IRS hackathon for 'one new API to rule them all' over taxpayer names, addresses, SSNs, returns, employment data; Palantir 'consistently' mentioned as candidate vendor; IRS worker: 'an open door controlled by Musk'

Treasury OIG-26-032 (8 June 2026 per Warren-Wyden letter): BFS sensitive payment systems controls 'generally adequate' but weaknesses; nine significant recommendations incl. Rules of Behavior before access and controls on unsecured external transmission of PII

Warren-Wyden letter 21 Jul 2026: per GAO, the DOGE employee sent unencrypted payment information about foreign aid to GSA, potentially exposing PII of over 350 individuals; a second DOGE employee had 'over the shoulder access' and BFS could not list what he viewed; OIG: '[n]egligence of access controls could lead to data breaches and system outages'

EO 14243 (20 Mar 2025): agency heads to ensure designated federal officials 'have full and prompt access to all unclassified agency records, data, software systems, and information technology systems'; does not mention DOGE
Palantir: 'not a vendor on any master database project to unify databases across federal agencies'; 'has no contracts with DOGE'; acts as data processor

de19_courts.topic: DOGE litigation: Privacy Act suits, AFSCME v. SSA, CREW FOIA case, Does v. Musk, AFGE v. OPM, New York v. Trump

claims.text: CRS LSB11370 (17 Sep 2025): 10 pending Privacy Act suits over DOGE access (Treasury, Labor, CFPB, Education, OPM, IRS, SSA); PIs denied for no irreparable harm in Alliance for Retired Americans v. Bessent, AFL-CIO v. Department of Labor, EPIC v. OPM; PI granted in AFGE v. OPM (S.D.N.Y.); AFT v. Bessent PI vacated by 4th Cir 12 Aug 2025; NY v. Trump modified PI on appeal; SCOTUS stayed AFSCME v. SSA PI 6 Jun 2025

AFSCME v. SSA: filed 21 Feb 2025 (D. Md.); Hollander TRO 20 Mar 2025; PI 17 Apr 2025 barring access to PII systems and ordering DOGE to delete non-anonymized PII; 4th Cir en banc denied stay 30 Apr; SCOTUS granted stay 6 Jun 2025, Kagan noting disagreement, Jackson dissent joined by Sotomayor; Notice of Corrections 16 Jan 2026 (Cloudflare, advocacy-group agreement, material misstatements); 4th Cir en banc 10 Apr 2026 vacated PI; 26 Jun 2026 district court allowed discovery into DOGE data handling citing government misrepresentations; ongoing

4th Cir en banc 10 Apr 2026 (Heytens): Part III (nine judges) plaintiffs likely have standing by analogy to intrusion upon seclusion; Part IV (joined only by Diaz and Harris) no irreparable harm shown on district record; refers to 'the even more recent—and even more alarming—allegations' not in the appellate record; Wilkinson n.2: 'The whistleblower report has not yet been substantiated'; King dissent joined by five: facts now known are much worse

SCOTUS 6 Jun 2025 In re U.S. DOGE Service: vacated D.C. Circuit denial of mandamus; stayed April 15 and May 20 discovery orders; parts requiring disclosure of content of USDS recommendations 'are not appropriately tailored'; 'separation of powers concerns counsel judicial deference and restraint'; did not decide whether USDS is a FOIA agency; Sotomayor, Kagan, Jackson would deny

NCC 15 Oct 2026: Supreme Court will hear CREW case (No. 25-1103) on discovery into whether USDS 'wields independent authority or is merely a board that exists to advise the president'; Judge Cooper found USDS 'likely an agency subject to FOIA'; argument early 2027

Does 1-26 v. Musk: Chuang PI 18 Mar 2025; 4th Cir stayed 28 Mar 2025; class certified 18 Aug 2025; 4th Cir mandamus 4 Mar 2026 blocked depositions of senior officials incl. Musk; in discovery as of Sept 2026

Chuang 18 Mar 2025: if Musk 'actually exercising significant authority', Appointments Clause cannot be a 'technical formality'; decision 'usurped the authority of the public's elected representatives in Congress'

AFGE v. OPM (S.D.N.Y., Cote J.) 20 Oct 2026: OPM violated Privacy Act by giving DOGE access; plaintiffs win APA claims; case not moot but relief uncertain; DOGE dissolved, no DOGE access to sensitive OPM data since Sept 2025; government 'barely defend[s] its legality'

New York v. Trump (19 states, Treasury): PI Feb 2025 limiting access without vetting; modified 27 May 2025; Vargas dismissed access claims as moot (DOGE team gone) and payment-review claims (no specific payment frozen) on 23 Sep 2026
NewsNation 20 Mar 2025: nearly a fifth of 132 cases against the administration related to Musk and DOGE

Reuters 23 May 2025: three sources said DOGE expanding use of customized Grok to analyse federal data; two said DOGE staff told DHS officials to use Grok though not approved there; Reuters could not determine what data entered; DHS denied pushing tools; Painter: appearance of pressure to enrich Musk and xAI
